# Tallow CRM Subscription Agreement (excerpt)

Customer: Brightfield Housing Trust
Vendor: Tallow Software GmbH
Initial term: 1 November 2025 to 31 October 2026
Agreement reference: TSW-BHT-2025-114

## 2. Definitions

2.1 "Named User Seat" means a licence assigned to one identified individual. Seats
may be reassigned between individuals but the assigned count is what is invoiced.
2.2 "Renewal Term" means each successive twelve (12) month period beginning at the
end of the Initial Term or of a preceding Renewal Term.
2.3 "Edition" means the Tallow Housing Edition, including the Case, Repairs and
Tenancy modules as configured at the Effective Date.

## 3. Fees

3.1 Subscription fees for the Initial Term: 60 named user seats at EUR 800 per seat
per year, total EUR 48,000, invoiced annually in advance.
3.2 Fees for any Renewal Term will be Vendor's then-current list price for the
Customer's Edition and seat count, unless otherwise agreed in writing.
3.3 Seat count may be reduced only with effect from the start of a Renewal Term and
only if requested in writing before the notice deadline in clause 9.2.
3.4 Additional seats purchased mid-term are charged pro rata at the then-current
list price and co-terminate with the current term.

## 4. Invoicing and payment

4.1 Invoices are issued in advance of each term.
4.2 Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of the invoice date.
4.3 Late payment interest accrues at 4% above base rate.

## 5. Support

5.1 Standard support is included: business hours, next business day response for
priority 3, four hours for priority 1.
5.2 Vendor will use reasonable endeavours to maintain 99.5% availability measured
monthly, excluding scheduled maintenance.
5.3 Service credits for missed availability are capped at 5% of the annual fee.

## 6. Data

6.1 Customer data remains the property of Customer.
6.2 On termination or expiry, Vendor will make Customer data available for export
in CSV and JSON for ninety (90) days, after which it is deleted.
6.3 Vendor processes personal data as processor under the terms of Annex 2.

## 7. Intellectual property

7.1 Nothing in this Agreement transfers ownership of the Software.
7.2 Customer configurations, reports and templates remain Customer's.

## 8. Liability

8.1 Neither party excludes liability for death, personal injury or fraud.
8.2 Otherwise each party's aggregate liability is capped at the fees paid in the
twelve months preceding the claim.

## 9. Term and termination

9.1 This Agreement renews automatically for successive twelve (12) month Renewal
Terms.
9.2 Either party may prevent renewal by giving written notice of non-renewal at
least thirty (30) days before the end of the then-current term.
9.3 Notices under this clause must be sent by email to contracts@tallow.example
and are effective on receipt.
9.4 Either party may terminate for material breach that remains uncured sixty (60)
days after written notice of the breach.
9.5 Termination does not relieve Customer of the obligation to pay fees already
invoiced for the then-current term.

## 11. General

11.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany.
11.2 Neither party may assign without the other's written consent, not to be
unreasonably withheld.
11.3 Amendments must be in writing and signed by both parties.

# Tallow CRM Renewal: Renew at 40 seats, expect EUR 38–42k

**Recommendation:** Renew for 40 seats instead of 60. Switching carries execution risk in winter (peak repairs season), and the system works. Reducing seats saves ~EUR 9,600 at current pricing and aligns capacity to actual use.

---

**AT A GLANCE**

| IN SCOPE | NOT IN SCOPE | DATA SOURCE | NEXT STEP |
|----------|--------------|-------------|-----------|
| Renew/cancel decision and seat count for FY27 | Alternative vendor evaluation, mid-term migration | Contract TSW-BHT-2025-114, Aug 2026 usage export, account manager emails | Email non-renewal notice by 1 Oct if not renewing; seat reduction request by same date |

---

## 01. We are paying for 60 seats and using 38

August 2026 usage shows 60 assigned seats, 38 active in the last 30 days. Finance (3 of 8 active), Fundraising (2 of 7), and Leadership (1 of 5) account for most waste. Housing Services and Tenant Repairs are the genuine users: 32 of the 38 active seats.

**Implication:** Cutting to 40 seats matches demand with a 5% buffer and eliminates EUR 16,000 of list-price capacity we do not use.

## 02. The arithmetic on 40 seats

Current spend: 60 seats × EUR 800 = EUR 48,000/year. At current list price, 40 seats = EUR 32,000. Vendor is launching new packaging in early October with updated pricing; account manager "would not expect anything dramatic" but gave no number. 

**Conservative estimate for FY27 budget:** EUR 38,000 to EUR 42,000 (assumes 15–20% list increase, nonprofit discount applied, 40 seats). This replaces the EUR 52,800 placeholder in Marek's board pack.

## 03. Switching risk is real and winter timing makes it worse

Aisha's team (Tenant Repairs) runs the Case module daily and the repairs export bug was only just fixed in release 9.4. A mid-winter CRM migration coincides with peak repairs demand. The system works now, and no alternative has been scoped or tested.

**If we do not renew:** 90-day data export window begins 1 November, deletion follows. Migration, training, and configuration would fall in Q4 2026 and Q1 2027, the worst possible window for housing operations.

## 04. The notice deadline is 1 October, not "plenty of time"

Contract clause 9.2 requires 30 days' written notice to prevent auto-renewal. Current term ends 31 October 2026. **Notice deadline: 1 October 2026** (16 days from now). Seat reduction requests go to the account manager (Lukas Brenner, back 28 September) and must be submitted before the same deadline. 

Vendor pricing will not be published until "early October," after the decision window closes. We are deciding without a firm quote.

## 05. The decision tree

| Scenario | Action required by 1 Oct | FY27 cost estimate | Operational impact |
|----------|--------------------------|-------------------|-------------------|
| **Renew at 40 seats** | Email Lukas: reduce to 40 seats effective 1 Nov | EUR 38–42k | None. Reassign unused seats if demand grows. |
| **Renew at 60 seats** | Do nothing (auto-renews) | EUR 57–66k | None, but EUR 16k+ wasted capacity continues. |
| **Cancel** | Email contracts@tallow.example: formal non-renewal notice | EUR 0 (FY27); migration cost TBD | High. 90 days to migrate all case data, reconfigure workflows, retrain 38 users during winter. |

---

## Renew at 40 seats. Notice required by 1 October.

**If actual usage climbs above 38 in Q2 2027, seats can be added mid-term (pro-rated, clause 3.4).** The contract allows growth; it does not allow retroactive seat reductions. Cut now, expand later if wrong.

**Kill condition:** If Tallow quotes above EUR 50,000 for 40 seats when pricing is published (early October), the nonprofit discount has disappeared or packaging has changed materially. Escalate immediately for renegotiation or emergency vendor review.

---

*Prepared 17 September 2026 for Priya Sundberg. Sources: Tallow contract TSW-BHT-2025-114, seat usage export August 2026, account manager correspondence 7–14 Sep, ops channel 7–14 Sep.*
